evidence_classes.manual_analytic: Reviewed identities, derivations, domain assumptions and limiting arguments in the actual current solutions and source equations. This is human-readable mathematical reasoning, not a formal proof-assistant certificate.
evidence_classes.symbolic: SymPy simplification/differentiation/integration and exact polynomial identities where present in the named checks; assumptions are recorded by the check.
evidence_classes.numerical: Finite deterministic quadrature, finite-difference, matrix, series and convergence samples with explicit tolerances; these are sample evidence, not universal proofs.
